method.placeholders: Parsed all 321 en and 321 target values of the eight namespaces with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser (requiresOtherClause). method.review: Every key read against its English value and context sidecar; the new keys also checked against their consumers (agents-page.tsx, config-composer.tsx, publication-failure.ts, public-teams-library.tsx, org-teams-list.tsx, upload-agent-dialog.tsx) for whole-sentence composition, aria label-in-name and layout. Terminology cross-checked against the core glossary, the es style guide and shipped es catalogues (ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub, ui.common.errors.teams_unsupported, ui.projects.project_start_session.team_manager_manager).

Raw-English {kind} in ui.agents.config.about and server-English {rule} in ui.agents.publication.invalid.field.*_with_rule are English source gaps, not translation defects. findings.problem: These four labels share one 288 px roster column (w-72, px-4 => 256px; the well's p-0.5 + 3 gaps leave 246px, 61.5px per equal segment; each Button is size=sm text-meta 0.75rem with px-2 padding and whitespace-nowrap). Measured with macOS SF Pro at 12px, the four strings need 34.3 + 85.6 + 57.8 + 60.6 = 238.3px of text, +64px padding = 302.3px, i.e. ~56px more than the row. English (All/Built-in/Custom/Installed) needs 210px and fits. The flex row cannot wrap and the labels cannot shrink (whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0), so the segments overflow the well or spill over each other.
findings.proposed: Shorten the set, e.g. Todos / Integrados / Propios / Del hub (measured 245.0px, 1px slack) or give this control more width / a 2x2 layout. If 'Propios' is adopted, align ui.agents.pages.empty.custom to 'No hay agentes propios.'; if 'Del hub' is adopted, keep the scope wording distinct from the hub tab and align empty.installed.

findings.problem: Round-1 nit, unchanged: understood but clipped as a sort option; the star action is 'Favoritos' elsewhere. 'Más veces en favoritos' is precise and still fits the w-48 trigger (~110px at 12px + padding < 192px).

findings.current: Descargar · Descargando… · Descargar el equipo {name} · No se pudo descargar “{name}”. · … Al descargar uno, se copia … · … para descargar un equipo en esta máquina. · No se pudo descargar el equipo. · … y vuelve a descargarlo.
findings.problem: The glossary's wave-2 kept-English set and the es style guide both keep `pull` for hub operations ('commit, push, pull, merge, rebase ... inflect around them; never translate inside them'), and the shipped catalogue already words the same operation as 'hacer pull de los equipos' (ui.common.errors.teams_unsupported). These keys translate it as descargar, so the hub surface contradicts the term decision and the shipped copy. Round-1 majors on public.intro and public.sign_in_hint were not applied; the new keys extend the same choice. No exception is recorded in the es style guide.
findings.proposed: Keep the verb `pull`: 'Pull' / 'Haciendo pull…' / 'Hacer pull del equipo {name}' / 'No se pudo hacer pull de “{name}”.' / 'Al hacer pull de uno, se copia …' / '… para hacer pull de un equipo en esta máquina.' / 'No se pudo hacer pull del equipo.' / '… y vuelve a hacer pull.' The aria name must keep the visible label ('pull') for label-in-name. If the product genuinely wants 'descargar', land that as a glossary/style-guide change first (a genuine contradiction goes back to the glossary), not as a catalogue-only divergence.

findings.problem: Round-1 minor left open: 'Responsable' is good Spanish and consistent inside this batch (hub.teams, agents.teams, agents.config), but the shipped projects surface prints the English 'manager:' (ui.projects.project_start_session.team_manager_manager = 'Equipo · manager: {manager}'). No es-guide row records which term wins across surfaces.
findings.proposed: Record `manager -> responsable` in the es style guide and align the shipped projects string, or keep 'manager' here for cross-surface consistency. Not gating; the wording itself is acceptable.

findings.current: No se descargó nada … vuelve a descargar. · La descarga no se completó · El equipo no se pudo descargar desde esta máquina · … y vuelve a descargar.
findings.problem: Same `pull` decision as ES-R2-H1: the English source says pulled/pull in these keys (it says 'downloaded/download' only in the pull.* refusal bodies, where 'descargar' is correct), and the glossary/style guide keep `pull`. The pull-surface bodies therefore use 'descargar' for the action the guides name 'pull'. Not applied from round 1's family finding.
findings.proposed: Use 'pull' for pulled/pull here: 'No se hizo pull de nada … vuelve a hacer pull.', 'El pull no se completó', 'No se pudo hacer pull del equipo desde esta máquina'. Leave the pull.* keys that say downloaded/download as 'descargar/descarga'.

findings.current: … o actualiza el backend si el hub se ha movido.
findings.problem: 'the hub has moved' is a calque: 'el hub se ha movido' reads as a physical move, not an endpoint/API change. Meaning is recoverable but not native product copy.
findings.proposed: … o actualiza el backend si el hub ha cambiado. (or 'si el hub ya no es el mismo')
